# Do Altcoins Outperform Bitcoin?

Purpose: Reproducible research comparing altcoin returns with Bitcoin over matched dates.
Author: Tobé Madu
Published snapshot: 2026-10-14
Repository: https://github.com/tcmadt/coin-history-research
Live paper: https://coin-history-research.teeceem5.chatgpt.site/

Recommended read order:
1. /AGENTS.md
2. /PROJECT_MANIFEST.json
3. /docs/CLAIMS.md
4. /dist/methodology.md
5. /docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md
6. Relevant scripts and generated outputs

Primary files:
- /dist/index.html: published paper
- /dist/app.js: chart and interaction logic
- /dist/data/: frozen observations and generated bundles
- /dist/*.csv: analysis and audit outputs
- /scripts/: generators and independent verification
- /research/: portfolio policy and preserved membership snapshots

Verification command: make verify

Critical cautions:
- Missing exit prices are unknown, not zero.
- Prices are not carried forward.
- Overlapping windows are not independent observations.
- The fixed cross-horizon cohort contains 279 coins.
- The repository includes the frozen derived snapshot, not the original aggregation workspace.
